dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent macro-annuli are located along the mid-dorsal and upper lateral regions, characterized by thin, high-contrast silver-grey perimeters encircling dark cores. Geometry includes a closed oval structure dorsal to the pectoral flipper, an elongated irregular ring posterior to the neck, and a complex interlocking 'C' shaped chain along the mid-lateral flank. Edge gradients are sharp, transitioning abruptly from high-intensity line-work to the low-intensity coat color.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of high-intensity pixels is highest along the lateral-midline where the annuli converge. These clusters form narrow, continuous bands rather than isolated blobs, with core pixel concentration peaking at the junctions of intersecting ring segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships between the centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated scalene triangle. A separate cluster of four centroids in the mid-lateral region forms an irregular quadrilateral with internal angles ranging from approximately 45 to 110 degrees.
